scope: Multi-label classification support in King Wen codebase

multi_label_symbol_classifier.description: Returns list of possible classifications with confidence scores
multi_label_symbol_classifier.contract: classify_symbol(ocr_text, aspect_ratio, fill_ratio, normalized_stroke, region_type) -> list[Classification]
multi_label_symbol_classifier.evidence: Three parallel classification paths (direct lookup, shape-based, region_type) accumulate into 'classifications' list; outputs 'classifications' and 'best_classification'

multi_label_benchmark_attribution.description: Multi-label paper attribution with attribution rule
multi_label_benchmark_attribution.evidence: "Category counts are multi-label and cannot be summed to unique paper totals without an attribution rule."

multi_label_pdf_parser.contract: Same list-returning classify_symbol() pattern as math_symbol_classifier.py

summary.requirement: Classify a single region/entry as multiple classes simultaneously
summary.coverage: 3 of 3 scripts checked implement some form of multi-label support
summary.direction: Reuse math_symbol_classifier.py's multi-label pattern as the canonical classification interface
